item.title: Order two different sandwiches for collection
item.context_text: You need lunch for two coworkers. Their orders are easy to confuse and one ingredient is sold out.
item.objective_text: Confirm a workable substitution and leave a receipt-style message.
success_conditions: Confirm a workable substitution and leave a receipt-style message.
Direct payment to the right place

children.title: Read the lunch orders
children.instructions: Read closely and use the details to answer.
children.prompt_text: Ana: egg sandwich on brown bread, no tomato. Tom: chicken sandwich on white bread, extra tomato. Both want still water.

questions.explanation: Tom’s order asks for extra tomato.

children.title: Hear the café’s update
children.instructions: Listen twice. First identify the update, then check the details you need.
children.prompt_text: We still have egg and chicken, but there is no brown bread today. We have white bread or wraps. Orders placed now are ready at twelve twenty. Pay at the pickup window, not at the till inside.

questions.explanation: The café is out of brown bread.
The update directs customers to the pickup window.

children.title: Ask for the right substitute
children.prompt_text: You know Ana prefers a wrap to white bread. Check the order with the café.
children.instructions: Give her revised order and repeat Tom’s unchanged order. Check the pickup time.
children.goal: Give an actionable response to what you just learned.
children.model_answer: Could Ana have the egg in a wrap with no tomato? Tom still wants chicken on white bread with extra tomato. Are both ready at twelve twenty?

children.title: Text the coworker collecting lunch
children.prompt_text: Your coworker has five minutes to collect lunch and pay.
children.instructions: Write both revised orders in full, include the drinks and say where to pay. Make the two names easy to spot.
children.goal: Confirm a workable substitution and leave a receipt-style message.
children.model_answer: Ana has an egg wrap with no tomato. Tom has chicken on white bread with extra tomato. There are two still waters. Please go to the pickup window at twelve twenty. You can collect and pay there, so do not wait at the till inside.

points.label: Direct payment to the right place
